description: Dental lab prescription intake, crown/bridge/implant restoration specifications, and shade matching.
system_instruction_addendum: Extract dental restoration parameters (Tooth Numbers FDI/Universal, Restoration Type, Shade/Color Guide code like A2/A3/B1, Material/Zirconia/PFM/Emax, Prep Date, Margin design). Understand Hinglish terms like 'daant number 14 ka crown', 'shade A2 zirconia', 'urgent implant bridge'.

fields.name: tooth_numbers
fields.label: Tooth #(s)
fields.description: Tooth numbers e.g. #14, #21, #46, or Upper Anterior

fields.name: restoration_type
fields.label: Restoration
fields.description: crown, bridge, veneer, implant, inlay_onlay, nightguard, denture

fields.name: material
fields.label: Material
fields.description: Zirconia Multi-layer, E-Max, PFM, Full Metal, PMMA Temporary

fields.name: shade
fields.label: Shade Guide
fields.description: VITA shade e.g. A1, A2, A3, B2, OM3 Bleach

fields.name: occlusal_clearance
fields.label: Clearance / Notes
fields.description: Occlusal staining, margin design (knife edge, chamfer)

few_shot_examples.input: Dr. Sharma here for patient Priya. Tooth 21 single crown chahiye in E-Max shade A2, urgent delivery in 2 days.

output.explanation: Single tooth #21 E-max crown requested by Dr. Sharma. Shade A2. Standard single unit.
